test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the satellite launched by ISRO which gives alert messages to fishermen regarding bad weather and high waves and cautions them when they approach international maritime boundary line?
solution:
The correct answer is **IRNSS-1I**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Indian Regional Navigation System is an independent regional navigation system developed by India.
 
• It is designed to provide accurate position information service to the users in India as well as the region extending up to 1500 km from its boundary which is its primary service area
